Coverage_Description: Covers residential interior renovation works with third-party legal liability; optional all-risks material damage and optional employees’ compensation/scaffolding cover; single contract up to 4 months, exterior work cost limit 20% of contract sum or HK$100,000
pricing: Premium table shown: HK$1,200-12,375 per policy depending on contract sum (HK$150,000-1,250,000), selected cover options, scaffolding option, and liability sum insured (HK$5,000,000-30,000,000).
customer requirement: Property owner/occupier or contractor company for residential renovation; policy must be accepted and in force before works commence
price structure: One-off premium matrix by contract sum × liability sum insured × cover package (Basic Third Party Liability vs with Optional Material Damage
additional informations: No refund after policy issuance; major exclusions include COVID-19/pandemic and works related to signboard/neon sign/cage/cladding; eClaim via myPrudential within 31 days after incident
